profile.headline: 7-128 Software
profile.summary:
Eric Jamison

I am an experienced software engineer, software test engineer, software quality assurance analyst, 

and Geographic Information Systems Analyst (GIS) and am looking for positions in these areas.

Specialties: * Languages: Java 6, Java Swing, JavaScript, XML, HTML, SQL

Technical Support/repairs:

Platforms: Windows (7/Vista/XP/Microsoft surface pro

UNIX (Solaris, HPUX, SGI, AIX), Red Hat Linux, Fedora Linux, SAN, NAS, iPad

* Databases: Oracle, MySQL, Access 

* Systems Administration: Software and hardware installation, configuration, problem resolution, backups, LAN and WAN

* GIS Software: ESRI ArcGIS 9.3.1, IDRISI Taiga, Google Maps

* Technical team lead

* Active Secret Security Clearance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: * Using Java 6 and Indigo Eclipse design and write code for an engine that will be used by educational and entertainment computer video games.

positions.title: Member of Executive Committee and Email Administrator (Part Time Volunteer)
positions.description: * Administrator of Yahoo email list for Westford Job Seekers networking group with over 400 members.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
* Created test plan and test cases. 

* Ran tests using Firefox with Firebug, and Google Chrome to quantify the time and calls associated between the front-end, the back-end and the database of a SaaS application demonstrating performance problems.

* Started to automate tests using Selenium 2, Java 6, Firefox, XML, and Indigo Eclipse.

positions.title: GIS Analyst
positions.description: * Volunteered to create map showing the town boundaries, stream and water body names, watershed boundaries, and locations of the water quality monitoring stations at each gage site in the Ipswich watershed using ESRI ArcGIS 9.3.1 and ArcGIS.com.

positions.title: Software QA Analyst
positions.description:
* Created and ran test plans for a web-based GUI application for the financial industry.

* Analyzed the results and created bug reports.

positions.title: GIS Technician
positions.description:
* Maintained, edited, and developed maintenance procedures for geodatabases associated with Citywide GIS deployment using ESRI ArcGIS 10.

* Worked with the City GIS staff to ensure that newly developed databases and map products meet City GIS standards for accuracy, content, and documentation.

* Worked with GIS user departments in meeting GIS project, analysis and mapping needs.

positions.title: Physical Scientist GIS Technician Intern
positions.description:
* Used ArcGIS 9.3.1 to symbolize streams and rivers at US coastline using National Hydrography Dataset (NHDPlus) to determine the amount of phosphorus and nitrogen loading. 

* Georegistered vector files using spatial adjustment tools to determine land use.

* Created bathymetry of river reaches using ArcInfo Workstation Arc 9.3.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
* Wrote test plans for tactical data link software using design and requirements specifications. 
* Tested software to verify it met requirements and performed correctly.
* Ran tests to confirm software bugs were fixed. 
* Verified software builds on CD's installed and worked properly.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Scientist
positions.description:
* Assisted in development a secure platform-independent web-based data archive management system for use in planning, managing, processing and accessing multi-spectral and hyper-spectral data collections using HTML, MySQL, Java, and Red Hat Linux. 

* Resolved software issues in existing Java and FORTRAN code, as well as ported the code to UNIX SGI, Red Hat and Fedora Linux systems. 

* Wrote software architectural design documents, requirements documents and data dictionary. Researched, wrote, and submitted proposals to fund research. 

* Provided technical support for PC’s including software and hardware installation, configuration, and problem resolution. 

* Helped to resolve networking issues and install network cables for LAN and WAN.

* Performed software backups on Linux Red Hat servers. 

* Monitored Symantec firewall that checked e-mail for spam and improperly rejected messages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Was the first engineering hire into an entrepreneurial startup network storage division software group within Sun and was the only engineer in the group for almost three months. Managed recruitment for the group.

* Performed needs assessment by gathering requirements for the functionality needed to complete our application and coordinated with engineers at other facilities to determine if their code could be incorporated into our application. Presented recommendations to manager. 

* Designed and developed a GUI prototype application using Java Swing.

* Developed JavaBeans using JDK 1.4, JSP’s, JavaScript and XML files for a web-based application using Apache Tomcat web server on Solaris to present numerical data in a graphical format.

* Designed, developed, and maintained a group resource HTML web page that serviced over 12,000 requests. 

* Team lead on two projects. Conducted brainstorming sessions to define functionality. Managed project hours. Assigned tasks to team members. Mentored junior members.

educations.fieldOfStudy: UNIX, UNIX Shell Programming, C, C++, FORTRAN, Pascal, Introduction to Data Structures
